en.title: Best Car Jump Starters 2026
en.description: HULKMAN, Fanttik, NOCO, GOOLOO, Clore, AstroAI and Taiwan's Philo and Mashin ranked by cold-weather starting range, published battery watt-hours, safety certification you can verify and engine ratings, with peak amp claims treated as a footnote.

zh-tw.title: 最佳電瓶救車電源 2026
zh-tw.description: HULKMAN、Fanttik、NOCO、GOOLOO、Clore、AstroAI，加上台灣的飛樂與麻新，依低溫啟動範圍、公開的電池瓦時、查得到的安全認證與適用排氣量排序，峰值電流只當參考。

en.description: HULKMAN's spec sheet lists a 74 Wh battery, 2,000 peak amps, ratings up to 8.5L gas and 6.0L diesel, and a working range down to -40°F, backed by a pre-heat mode that warms the pack when you connect it. It is the only pack on my list built around the cold morning that actually kills batteries, and the store runs it at $299.99 list with a $100 code at checkout.

zh-tw.description: 官方規格表寫得很清楚，74Wh 電池、2,000A 峰值，汽油 8.5L、柴油 6.0L，工作溫度最低到華氏負 40 度，接上電瓶會先自動預熱電芯再放電。老實說，全榜只有它是認真為寒流早上設計的，官網定價 299.99 美元，結帳輸入折扣碼折 100 美元。

en.description: Fanttik prints the capacity as 20,000 mAh and 74 Wh, rates it for 8.5L gas and 6.0L diesel, and states conformity with UL 2743, the North American standard for portable power packs. The 65 W USB-C PD port recharges it in about 1.5 hours and doubles as a laptop charger. The standard kit showed $99.99 and sold out when I checked.

zh-tw.description: Fanttik 直接標出 20,000mAh 與 74Wh，汽油 8.5L、柴油 6.0L，官網寫明符合 UL 2743 攜帶式電源包安全標準。65W USB-C PD 雙向快充，約 1.5 小時充滿，平常還能拿來充筆電。同樣 74Wh 的容量只要一百美元，這個 CP 值我很難挑剔，只是我去看的時候標準版剛好賣完。

en.description: The GB70 carries a 56 Wh lithium battery, 2,000 peak amps, ratings of 8.0L gas and 6.0L diesel, up to 40 jump starts per charge and an IP65 enclosure, at $199.95 on NOCO's own store. For a V8 pickup or a diesel SUV this is the NOCO I would keep in the truck.

zh-tw.description: 56Wh 鋰電池、2,000A 峰值，汽油 8.0L、柴油 6.0L，官網寫一次充飽最多救 40 次，IP65 防水防塵，NOCO 官網 199.95 美元。開大排氣量休旅或柴油皮卡的人，NOCO 家我會直接推這台。

en.description: Amazon's best-selling jump starter packs a 24 Wh battery, 1,000 peak amps, ratings of 6.0L gas and 3.0L diesel, IP65 and up to 20 starts, at $99.95 on NOCO's store. Its manual lists an operating range of -30°C to 50°C and a charging range of 0°C to 40°C, and TechGearLab started a drained 4-liter V6 with it three times in a row at 33°F.

zh-tw.description: Amazon 賣最好的救車電源，24Wh、1,000A 峰值，汽油 6.0L、柴油 3.0L，IP65，最多救 20 次，官網 99.95 美元。說明書寫工作溫度負 30 到 50 度、充電溫度 0 到 40 度，TechGearLab 在華氏 33 度的天氣下，用它連續三次發動電瓶完全沒電的 4.0L V6。體積小到能塞手套箱，一般轎車買這台就很夠。

en.description: The GBX45 steps up to a 31 Wh battery, 1,250 peak amps and ratings of 6.5L gas and 4.0L diesel while weighing 2.16 lb, lighter than the GB40. It adds USB-C in and out and a 400-lumen light for $124.95, which makes it my pick for small SUVs and compact diesels.

zh-tw.description: 31Wh、1,250A 峰值，汽油 6.5L、柴油 4.0L，重量 2.16 磅，比 GB40 還輕。多了 USB-C 雙向充電跟 400 流明的燈，官網 124.95 美元。家裡是小休旅或小排氣量柴油車，多花 25 美元升級到這台很值得。

en.description: Philo is a Taiwan brand, and its official store sells this 12,000 mAh pack for NT$3,480 with 800 peak amps, support for gas engines up to 5,000cc and diesel up to 3,500cc, a smart clamp with temperature protection and BSMI registration R51275. It covers every family car I see in Taiwan's parking garages and carries a one-year warranty.

zh-tw.description: 飛樂是台灣品牌，官網 NT$3,480，12,000mAh、800A 峰值，汽油車 5,000cc、柴油車 3,500cc 以內都能救，智慧電瓶夾有溫度保護，商檢字號 R51275。台灣路上的國產車、日系休旅幾乎都在它的範圍內，保固一年，要在台灣買一台有保固、有字號的，我先推這台。

en.description: Tow trucks and repair shops have used this lead-acid box for decades. Clore publishes 425 cranking amps next to the 1,700 peak figure, and it ships with 46-inch #2 AWG welding-cable leads and built-in auto recharging. At 18 lb it lives in a garage or a truck bed, and retailers sell it for roughly $130 to $187.

zh-tw.description: 拖吊車跟修車廠用了幾十年的鉛酸救車器，Clore 在 1,700A 峰值旁邊直接標出 425A 啟動電流，這是全榜少數敢標持續電流的。附 46 吋 #2 AWG 焊接線，內建自動充電電路，插著就能隨時待命。重 18 磅，放車庫或皮卡後斗用，美國通路大約 130 到 187 美元。

competitors.name: A3 Jump Starter with Air Compressor

en.description: GOOLOO's A3 combines a 3,000-peak-amp jump starter rated for 9.0L gas and 6.5L diesel with a 150 PSI tire inflator, an operating range of -4°F to 140°F, a claimed 90% charge after 24 months on the shelf and a 30-month warranty. It is the best two-in-one for a trunk kit at $89.99 on sale from $125.99.

zh-tw.description: GOOLOO A3 是救車電源加 150 PSI 打氣機二合一，峰值 3,000A，汽油 9.0L、柴油 6.5L，工作溫度華氏負 4 到 140 度，官方說放 24 個月還有 90% 電量，保固 30 個月，官網特價 89.99 美元。後車廂只想放一台東西，同時處理沒電跟胎壓，選它最省空間。

en.description: Mashin Electric is a Taiwan maker, and the SP-800+ pairs 8,000 mAh cells (5,000 mAh rated) with 600 peak amps, support for gas engines up to 4,000cc and diesel up to 3,000cc, 1 V low-voltage starting, BSMI registration R65062 on its momo listing and NT$20 million in product liability insurance. It sells for NT$2,850 on momo.

zh-tw.description: 麻新電子是台灣廠牌，SP-800+ 電芯 8,000mAh、額定 5,000mAh，600A 峰值，汽油 4,000cc、柴油 3,000cc 以內，有 1V 低電壓啟動，momo 商品頁列出商檢字號 R65062，另外投保 2,000 萬產品責任險。momo 促銷 NT$2,850，開 1.8 到 2.5 升國產轎車的人，這個價位買它很剛好。

en.description: The S8 is the cheapest lithium pack on my list at $59.99 on AstroAI's store, with a 10,000 mAh NMC battery, 1,500 peak amps, ratings of 6.0L gas and 3.0L diesel, a three-mode flashlight and a weight of about 800 g. It suits a commuter sedan in a mild climate, and the store showed it sold out in September.

zh-tw.description: 官網 59.99 美元，是全榜最便宜的鋰電款，10,000mAh 三元鋰電池、1,500A 峰值，汽油 6.0L、柴油 3.0L，附三段手電筒，重約 800 公克。天氣溫和、每天通勤開小轎車的人，拿它當保險很划算，九月我去看的時候官網顯示缺貨。

en.commentary:
I ranked these ten packs by the numbers that decide whether your car starts on a frozen morning, and I pushed peak amps to the bottom of the pile. Peak amps is a millisecond burst with no industry definition and no third-party audit. The market proves it: in asinsight's July tracking of Amazon's jump starter chart, the NOCO GB40 sold about 40,000 units a month at $79.96 with a 1,000A label, while an OXILAM pack labeled 6,000A sold for $59.99 and a GOOLOO A3 labeled 3,000A sold for $69.97. The bigger the sticker number, the lower the price.

What I trust is the battery's watt-hours, the maker's engine-size rating, the temperature range printed in the manual, and a safety standard someone other than the seller can check. Battery makers define cold cranking amps as current held for 30 seconds at 0°F above 7.2 volts. Almost no portable pack publishes that figure, so the Clore JNC660 earns real credit for printing 425 cranking amps.

HULKMAN's Alpha 85S takes first place because it is engineered for the exact moment a jump starter matters. It publishes 74 Wh, a -40°F working range and a pre-heat mode that warms the cells before discharge. Fanttik's T8 APEX sits one step behind with the same 74 Wh, a stated UL 2743 conformity and a $99.99 price that makes it the best value here.

NOCO takes three of my top five. The GB70 is the one for big engines, the GB40 remains the glove-box default and passed TechGearLab's drained-V6 test three times at 33°F, and the GBX45 is the lighter upgrade with USB-C. I docked NOCO on certification because none of the three product pages lists a safety standard.

Safety is the reason that column exists. On November 14, 2025, the CPSC told owners to stop using HALO Bolt ACDC 58830 packs made before December 2019 after fire and burn reports, and noted that battery age raises the risk of thermal runaway. Buy a pack with a certification you can look up, and replace it once it has aged.

For Taiwan buyers, Philo's AH-12000SP and Mashin's SP-800+ carry BSMI registrations and local warranties, and both cover the family cars that fill Taiwan's roads.

highlights.title: Watt-hours tell you more than the peak amp sticker
highlights.body: A pack's battery energy is the number I can compare across brands, and it lines up with how many attempts you get on a dead battery. HULKMAN and Fanttik both publish 74 Wh, NOCO publishes 24 Wh for the GB40, 31 Wh for the GBX45 and 56 Wh for the GB70. GOOLOO's A3 page prints 3,000 peak amps and a 9.0L gas rating without a watt-hour figure, which is why I scored its energy transparency at 6.0 even though I like the kit.

highlights.title: HULKMAN Alpha 85S is the pack I would buy for a real winter
highlights.body: Lithium cells lose output in the cold, and AAA's own newsroom warns that dead-battery calls surge during winter storms. HULKMAN attacks that problem directly with a published -40°F working range and a pre-heat mode that warms the pack when you connect the clamps. Pair that with 74 Wh and an 8.5L gas rating and you get the most complete cold-weather pack I found, at $199.99 after the store's $100 code.

highlights.title: The GB40 still earns its place in millions of glove boxes
highlights.body: NOCO's GB40 sells around 40,000 units a month on Amazon because it is small, IP65 sealed and simple. Its manual lists an operating range of -30°C to 50°C, and TechGearLab started a drained 4-liter V6 with it three times in a row at 33°F. For a sedan or small crossover under 6.0 liters it is the easiest recommendation on this page. My one deduction is the missing certification on the product page.

highlights.title: Certification is the column that protects you from a fire
highlights.body: The CPSC's November 2025 warning on HALO Bolt ACDC 58830 packs cited fires and a burn injury, and said the age of the product makes lithium thermal runaway more likely. UL 2743 is the North American safety standard for portable power packs, and Fanttik states conformity on its site. In Taiwan, BSMI registration does the same job, and Philo (R51275) and Mashin (R65062) both publish their numbers. I score what a buyer can look up, so packs that list no standard get a 7.0.

highlights.title: Clore JNC660 is the professional's answer to honest numbers
highlights.body: A lead-acid pack that weighs 18 lb looks old-fashioned next to a pocket-sized lithium brick, and it still wins where shops need it. Clore prints 425 cranking amps alongside the 1,700 peak rating, ships 46-inch #2 AWG welding-cable leads and keeps itself topped up with a built-in charger. If you run a fleet or a garage, this is the box I would mount on the wall.

zh-tw.commentary:
這份榜單我用「寒流早上車子發不發得動」來排，峰值電流被我擺到最後參考。

講白了，峰值電流是毫秒等級的瞬間數字，沒有產業標準定義，也沒有第三方稽核。市場數據就是最好的證明，asinsight 追蹤 Amazon 七月的熱賣榜，NOCO GB40 標 1,000A、賣 79.96 美元、月銷約 4 萬台，OXILAM 標 6,000A 只賣 59.99 美元，GOOLOO A3 標 3,000A 賣 69.97 美元。包裝上的數字越大，價格反而越低。

我相信的是四個東西：電池瓦時、官方標的適用排氣量、說明書裡的工作溫度，還有能讓別人查證的安全認證。電瓶業的冷啟動電流定義，是華氏 0 度下持續 30 秒、電壓維持 7.2V 以上，攜帶型救車電源幾乎都不標，所以 Clore JNC660 敢印出 425A 啟動電流，我給它加分。

第一名給 HULKMAN Alpha 85S，我很有把握。它公開 74Wh、工作溫度最低華氏負 40 度，接上電瓶會先預熱電芯再放電，整台就是為救車最需要的那個冷天早上設計的。Fanttik T8 APEX 緊跟在後，一樣 74Wh，官網寫明符合 UL 2743，99.99 美元的價格是全榜最划算。

NOCO 在我的前五名佔了三席。GB70 適合大排氣量，GB40 還是手套箱的標準配備，TechGearLab 在華氏 33 度用它連續三次發動沒電的 V6，GBX45 則是更輕、有 USB-C 的升級款。三台的官網商品頁都沒列安全認證，這一欄我照實扣分。

認證欄存在的理由很實際。美國 CPSC 在 2025 年 11 月 14 日要求消費者停用 2019 年 12 月以前製造的 HALO Bolt ACDC 58830，因為已有起火與燙傷通報，CPSC 也指出電池老化會提高熱失控風險。

回到台灣。老實說，平地冬天很少冷到讓鋰電池出問題，台灣車主更該注意的是夏天把救車電源丟在曝曬的車廂裡，NOCO 說明書寫的平均存放溫度上限是 50 度，這點大家要放在心上。

另外，行動電源從 2014 年 5 月 1 日起就是標檢局的應施檢驗商品，合格品會有 R 字軌的商品檢驗標識。我在比價網上找不到 NOCO 的台灣官方代理，蝦皮上都是第三方賣場。想在台灣買得安心，飛樂 AH-12000SP 跟麻新 SP-800+ 都有字號、有在地保固，救國產轎車跟日系休旅綽綽有餘。

highlights.title: 看瓦時就對了，峰值電流貼紙參考就好
highlights.body: 電池瓦時是我唯一能跨品牌直接比較的數字，也跟你能救幾次車直接相關。HULKMAN 跟 Fanttik 都公開 74Wh，NOCO 的 GB40 是 24Wh、GBX45 是 31Wh、GB70 是 56Wh。GOOLOO A3 商品頁寫了 3,000A 跟汽油 9.0L，卻找不到瓦時，所以這一欄我只給 6.0，雖然我其實滿喜歡這台二合一的設計。

highlights.title: 真的會遇到寒流，我就買 HULKMAN Alpha 85S
highlights.body: 鋰電池一冷輸出就掉，AAA 也提醒暴風雪期間電瓶沒電的救援電話會暴增。HULKMAN 直接正面處理這件事，官方工作溫度最低到華氏負 40 度，夾上電瓶就會先預熱。再加上 74Wh、汽油 8.5L 的額定，這是我找到最完整的寒地救車電源，官網用折扣碼折完 199.99 美元。

highlights.title: GB40 能賣到月銷四萬台，是有道理的
highlights.body: NOCO GB40 在 Amazon 每個月賣約 4 萬台，原因很簡單：小、IP65、好上手。說明書寫工作溫度負 30 到 50 度，TechGearLab 在華氏 33 度連續三次發動沒電的 4.0L V6。6.0L 以內的轎車跟小休旅，買這台最不用想。我唯一扣分的地方，是官網商品頁沒有列出安全認證。

highlights.title: 認證欄是在保護你家的車子不會燒起來
highlights.body: 美國 CPSC 2025 年 11 月對 HALO Bolt ACDC 58830 發出停用警告，已有起火跟燙傷通報，也點出產品年限會讓鋰電池更容易熱失控。北美看 UL 2743，Fanttik 官網有寫明符合。台灣看標檢局字號，飛樂（R51275）跟麻新（R65062）都公開得清清楚楚。我只給讀者查得到的認證分數，沒列標準的一律 7.0。

highlights.title: 在台灣買，飛樂跟麻新是最安心的選擇
highlights.body: 行動電源早在 2014 年 5 月 1 日就列入應施檢驗，合格品會有 R 字軌標識，出問題也找得到負責廠商。飛樂 AH-12000SP 官網 NT$3,480，汽油 5,000cc、柴油 3,500cc 都能救；麻新 SP-800+ 在 momo 賣 NT$2,850，汽油 4,000cc 以內沒問題，還有 2,000 萬產品責任險。家裡是國產轎車或日系休旅，這兩台就很夠用了，老實說我會先挑飛樂，排氣量範圍多一截。
